newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in slow after-hours trade on Wednesday, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen per kg lower to 0.8 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark April was 0.5 yen lower at 140.0 yen. Volume was 6,786 lots.
During the day, prices opened lower, but bargain-hunting in distant months limited price losses.
"Market sentiment remained bearish due to a dearth of bullion factors, and the spot November contract could fall below 130 yen," one trader said.
